# Omni Calculator

> > Omni Calculator provides specialized calculators across science, health, construction, and everyday life topics, from chemistry calculations to pet care tools.

A comprehensive collection of domain-specific calculators covering chemistry (pH, molarity, Langmuir isotherms), biology (GDU, wastewater treatment), health metrics (HOMA-IR, BMI), pet care (cage sizing, age conversion), and construction. Available in multiple languages including English, German, Polish, Portuguese, French, and Dutch.

## Key Topics

- Chemistry calculations (pH, molar mass, percent solutions)
- Biology and agriculture (GDU, wastewater, soil volume)
- Pet care (fancy rats, turtles, cats, birds)
- Health metrics (HOMA-IR, BMI, FBMI)
- Langmuir isotherm and adsorption models
- Enzyme kinetics (Michaelis-Menten equation)
- Construction and materials estimation
- Physics (kinematics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism)
- Mathematics (geometry, trigonometry, algebra)
- Avogadro's constant and mole conversions
- BOD and COD in wastewater treatment
- Growing Degree Units (GDU/GDD)
- Age conversion for pets
- Shannon-Wiener Index
- Multi-language support (DE, PL, PT, FR, NL)

## Category Hubs

- [Construction Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/construction): Construction category hub for materials, measurements, and cost estimation
- [Physics Calculators](https://www.omnicalculator.com/nl/natuurkunde): Physics category hub covering kinematics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism
- [Kalkulatory matematyczne](https://www.omnicalculator.com/pl/matematyka): Mathematics category hub for geometry, trigonometry, and algebra tools
- [Calculadoras de Saúde](https://www.omnicalculator.com/pt/saude): Health category hub covering BMI, metabolism, medications, and HOMA-IR
- [Kalkulatory zdrowotne](https://www.omnicalculator.com/pl/zdrowie): Health category hub with WHR, HOMA-IR, BSA, and FFMI calculators

## Chemistry Calculators

- [Percent Solution Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/chemistry/percent-solution): Calculates mass/volume, mass, and volume percentages of chemical solutions
- [Michaelis-Menten Equation Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/chemistry/michaelis-menten-equation): Computes enzyme kinetics using Michaelis constant and Vmax parameters
- [Calculateur de masse molaire](https://www.omnicalculator.com/fr/chimie/calculateur-masse-molaire): Calculates molar mass using Avogadro's constant and periodic table data
- [Kalkulator moli](https://www.omnicalculator.com/pl/chemia/mole): Converts between moles, molecular mass, and mass using Avogadro's number
- [Langmuir Isotherm Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/chemistry/langmuir-isotherm): Computes adsorbent surface coverage using Langmuir adsorption model
- [Calculadora de Concentração de Íons de Hidrogênio](https://www.omnicalculator.com/pt/quimica/calculadora-concentracao-ions-de-hidrogenio): Determines hydrogen ion concentration from pH using acid-base chemistry
- [Calculadora de Massa Atômica Média](https://www.omnicalculator.com/pt/quimica/calculadora-massa-atomica-media): Calculates average atomic mass from isotopic mass and natural abundance

## Biology and Agriculture Calculators

- [Wastewater Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/biology/wastewater): Models activated sludge process with BOD, COD, and F/M ratio calculations
- [GDU Calculator | Growing Degree Units](https://www.omnicalculator.com/biology/gdu): Calculates Growing Degree Units (GDU/GDD) for crop development tracking
- [Kalkulator gleby | Ile gleby potrzebujesz?](https://www.omnicalculator.com/pl/biologia/gleba): Estimates topsoil volume and cost for gardening and agriculture projects

## Pet Care Calculators

- [Rat Cage Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/biology/rat-cage): Determines appropriate cage size for fancy rats and rodent housing needs
- [Turtle Tank Size Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/biology/turtle-tank): Determines aquarium size for Red-eared Slider and other turtle species
- [Cat BMI Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/biology/cat-bmi): Calculates Feline Body Mass Index (FBMI) for cat health assessment
- [Vogelalter Rechner](https://www.omnicalculator.com/de/biologie/vogelalter-rechner): Converts bird age to human years for pet birds and ornamental species

## Optional

- [Tree Leaves Calculator | How Many Leaves Are on a Tree?](https://www.omnicalculator.com/biology/tree-leaves): Estimates leaf count on trees for autumn raking and foliage collection
